description: Fetches detailed metadata for a single Instagram post or reel by shortcode or URL. 2 Firecrawl credits when ScrapeCreators charges its 1 credit; a cache hit or an uncharged empty page costs nothing.

billing.description: ScrapeCreators' dearest published rate is $0.00188 per credit ($47 for 25,000). One credit is 2 Firecrawl credits. A call quotes 1 credit and settles on credits_charged, so a cache hit charged at 0 costs nothing. An empty page can still be charged.

options.description: Instagram post or reel URL.

options.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response.
options.name: trim

options.description: If we have a response in the cache that is this many days old or newer, return the cached response (0 credits, with "cached": true and a "cached_at" timestamp). Otherwise, scrape a live result (1 credit). See the Caching page for details.
options.name: cache_max_age

options.description: Set to false to omit `video_play_count` and skip its additional fetch for a faster response. Defaults to true.
options.name: include_play_count
